description: This file contains helper functions for determining and computing the Quality of Service (QoS) class of Kubernetes pods, based on resource requests and limits, including support for pod-level resources and container-specific resources.

methods.name: isSupportedQoSComputeResource
methods.description: Checks if a resource name is supported for QoS computation (CPU or Memory).

methods.name: GetPodQOS
methods.description: Returns the QoS class of a pod, based on its status or computed from resources.

methods.name: ComputePodQOS
methods.description: Evaluates container requests and limits to determine the QoS class of a pod (BestEffort, Guaranteed, Burstable).
